conditionalOnlyIfEffectiveFormatIsWav.scope: Existing speech model configuration, not provider credentials
conditionalOnlyIfEffectiveFormatIsWav.reason: A model-level format overrides an inherited provider-level WAV value. Qwen reads format, not response_format or codec.

existingSettingsRoute.field: Current speech model editor / Format / mp3
existingSettingsRoute.wirePayloadRule: Deep-copy the complete current model config, set only config.format=mp3, and submit the full config. The API replaces config; the set object above is not a complete PUT payload.
